hero.subtitle: SchoolWatch brings attendance, academics, finance, boarding and communication into one clear experience — so updates move from the classroom to the right people.

portals.title: One platform, focused experiences for every role.
portals.subtitle: Everyone signs in to the same connected school — and sees only what matters to them.
portals.parent1: Attendance and homework at a glance

capabilities.title: Less scattered information. More clarity.
capabilities.attendanceBody: Daily register, late arrivals and absence follow-up in one flow.
capabilities.performanceBody: Exams, grading rules, monthly evaluations and student progress.
capabilities.homeworkBody: Assigned, submitted, reviewed — visible to teachers and families.
capabilities.announcementsBody: School-wide or class-level notices that actually reach people.
capabilities.communicationBody: Messages between staff and families, kept in school context.
capabilities.eventsBody: Calendars, trips and parent evenings with confirmations.

modules.title: The depth schools ask for, built in.
modules.financeBody: Fees, payment plans, scholarships and overdue follow-ups tracked per student — with receipts families can see in their own portal.
modules.finance1: Invoice status across the whole school
modules.researchBody: Proposals, milestones, deliverables and a shared calendar — managed on a kanban board that students and supervisors share.
modules.boardingBody: Accommodation, boarding attendance and incident records.
modules.academicBody: Years, semesters, classes, subjects and schedules.
modules.peopleBody: Students, teachers, parents and granular permissions.
modules.aiBody: Insights and answers drawn from your own school data.
modules.mobileTitle: Mobile apps for families and staff
modules.mobileBody: Live attendance, homework and announcements — pushed the moment they happen.

workflow.title: From school update to family visibility.
workflow.step1Body: Attendance, a grade or a homework note in class.
workflow.step2Body: Rules, roles and permissions decide who sees what.
workflow.step3Body: Parents get the update in the app, in English or Arabic.
workflow.step4Body: Everything stays in the student's record for the year.

why.title: Why schools choose SchoolWatch.
why.clarityBody: One source of truth for the school day, not five chat groups.
why.securityBody: Secure login for parents, teachers and school staff.
why.rolesBody: Permissions that match how a real school is organised.
why.connectedBody: Operations, academics and communication in one place.

cta.title: Your school day should feel connected.
cta.subtitle: Secure login for parents, teachers and school staff — in English or Arabic.

footer.tagline: One connected experience for the whole school community.
